release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.9: adds Korean (한국어) as the 8th interface language across the panel, Telegram bot, AI assistant, automation notifications, funnel bot, push-unsubscribe page, and Analytics formatting; centers the tracker navigation bar with smart spacing across narrow, desktop, and ultrawide screens; fixes floating-point noise on Analytics Trends and Cohort percent axes; applies the signed-in user's profile language and week-start immediately on login without a page reload.
